programme.title: Dhadkan

programme.title: Katilon Ke Kaatil
programme.desc: A wealthy widow meets Munna and Ajit and assumes them to be her estranged sons. She takes them into her house, unaware that their intentions are to loot her entire wealth.

programme.title: Rustum

programme.desc: At AMT Headingley Stadium, Leeds Rhinos and York Valkyrie battle it out in a Betfred Women's Super League semi-final. (22.09)

programme.title: S/Lge Highlights
programme.desc: The Totally Wicked Stadium stages the second Betfred Women's Super League semi-final, as St Helens and Wigan Warriors collide. (22.09)

programme.title: S/Lge Highlights
programme.desc: Bitesize highlights from the Betfred World Club Challenge, as the Wigan Warriors host the NRL's Penrith Panthers at the DW Stadium in one of club rugby league's biggest encounters. (24.02)

programme.title: S/Lge Highlights
programme.desc: Third meets fourth as Warrington Wolves host St Helens in the Betfred Super League. The Saints arrive with winning momentum behind them after defeating Huddersfield in round 24. (07.09)

programme.title: S/Lge: St Helens v Leigh
programme.desc: St Helens play host to Leigh Leopards in the Betfred Super League. The Saints and the Leopards are separated by just a single point, currently sitting in fourth and third respectively.

programme.title: S/Lge Highlights
programme.desc: St Helens host Catalans Dragons in the Betfred Super League. Saints ran away with a 40-10 win over Leeds Rhinos last week to go top of the table. (31.05)

programme.title: NFL Highlights
programme.desc: The Seattle Seahawks attempt to hang on to their one-game lead in the NFC West in a week 17 contest with the Carolina Panthers, who are in position to clinch the NFC South. (28.12)

programme.title: Zuffa Boxing: Smith v Rozicki Hlts
programme.desc: Bournemouth's own Chris Billam-Smith headlines Zuffa Boxing's first UK show against fearsome fighter Ryan Rozicki as the pair go toe-to-toe across 10 rounds of cruiserweight boxing. (06.06)

programme.title: Live NRL: Storm v Raiders
programme.desc: Out to build on their recent streak of winning form, Melbourne - recharged after a bye week - host a Canberra Raiders side looking to end a run of four defeats in their past five matches.

programme.title: Live NRL: Roosters v Sharks
programme.desc: The Sydney Roosters encounter the Cronulla Sharks during round 16 of the 2026 NRL season. The Sharks eye another confidence-boosting win after their unlikely 10-8 triumph over the Warriors.

programme.title: S/Lge Highlights
programme.desc: The 2024 Betfred Super League play-offs continue with an eliminator match-up as Salford Red Devils and Leigh Leopards battle it out for a place in the semi-finals. (27.09)

programme.title: NFL Highlights
programme.desc: The Seahawks and the Patriots enter a Santa Clara showdown as Super Bowl LX is here. This contest comes as a repeat of the 2015 Super Bowl - a day that belonged to the Patriots. (08.02)

programme.title: NBA Playoffs
programme.desc: It's the defending NBA champions Oklahoma City Thunder for LeBron James and Los Angeles Lakers as this Western Conference semi-final from the NBA playoffs gets underway with Game One.

programme.title: Men's State Of Origin #1 Hlts
